title: Japan Power Trading Dashboard
subtitle: Spot-Price Forecasting for Japan's Power Market
description: Spot-price forecasting and trading strategies for the Japanese power market, later extended to Australia. It turns out electricity prices have moods too.
longDescription: Leading the development of sophisticated AI trading strategies for international power markets. The system uses advanced time series analysis and machine learning models to predict electricity spot market prices, helping traders make data-driven decisions in volatile energy markets.
solutions: Implemented robust time series models with PyTorch
Built scalable data pipeline with Elasticsearch
Created modular API architecture with Django
results: Successfully deployed prediction models for Japan market
Achieved 85% accuracy in price trend prediction
why: Built at HD Renewables for the power-trading desks in Japan and later Australia, who need a view of the spot price before they trade. The market stays volatile; the idea was that the decisions would not.
